manifest.description: Diagnose Rust trait boundaries that are missing, too broad, too narrow, or acting as service-locator-style abstractions.
when_to_use: callers should depend on a trait surface instead of a concrete type
an existing trait mixes unrelated responsibilities or hides service-locator behavior
generic parameter bloat suggests a missing boundary
anti_patterns: do not use for object-safety errors the compiler can state by itself
do not map broad-trait remediation to rust-trait-from-impl; that atom only creates missing trait surfaces
do not use on non-Rust targets
